title: Flip clock from a time element
blurb: One <time> element whose text changes once a second. The canvas flips each changed digit from a snapshot of the old text to the new text. The frames of the flip come from a CSS animation on the element, so the page has no frame loop.
question: Can a canvas animation run on paint events alone, with no requestAnimationFrame() and no requestPaint()?
result: Yes. A text change fires paint, and an animation of a registered custom property fires it every frame when a painted colour is computed from the property. The property alone fires nothing.
